decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block references, limits the fiat-buyer section to the $500 Small Block draw, and updates the primary-mint split.
The existing same-message MODIFY completely records the $5 founder, $5 affiliate, and $5 Small Block pool allocation and removes Big Block from the recipient list.
The existing same-message MODIFY replaces the ticket and prize-draw copy with Small Block-only descriptions; no remaining attribute necessarily requires modification.
The existing same-message MODIFY deletes the obsolete big_block_prize_copy key while preserving the valid Small Block copy.
Removing Big Block does not change the established automatic wallet-transfer behavior for winners of the surviving Small Block prize.
The existing same-message MODIFY replaces the two-counter metadata list with a Small Block-only counter list, fully capturing the necessary metadata impact.
The source explicitly retains the $5 affiliate allocation and does not change the coded-referral commission trigger, recipient, timing, or delivery behavior.
The existing same-message MODIFY narrows notification scope from Small and Big Block prizes to the surviving Small Block context.
The source preserves the $15 primary-mint price and changes only its internal revenue allocation.
Removing Big Block and reallocating one dollar does not change the NFT ebook product type or unlimited primary-mint supply model.

The stated $15 buy split concerns primary mints; it does not change the flat secondary royalty, its founder allocation, ticket-generation rule, or the continuing contribution of secondary royalties to the surviving prize pool.
The transfer semantics are generic to active and expired prize tickets and remain valid for Small Block tickets after Big Block removal.
